AN/HXQ-7 · HYPERDIMENSIONAL EXTRACTION IMAGING ENGINE · BLOCK I

SEPTEMVIR HX-7

A live engine that rotates regular polytopes (hypercube, orthoplex, simplex, 24-cell) on golden-ratio spin locks, from four to seven dimensions, and projects them into the box in front of you. Sacred-geometry rings turn around them and lasers fire in every direction.

Six objectives ride on the hyperfaces. The film runs seven phases in 7:07, with a live-synthesised military score: brass, strings, drums and timpani. Four national anthems are on exhibit below. Pull the object out of the screen with EXTRACT, or put on red/cyan glasses and switch Stereo to Anaglyph.
